name: tenmol
description: React web front-end for the PyMOL engine in this repository (monorepo root).

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names bridge,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "pnpm run dev:bridge" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.//test:ci: CI gate. `pnpm test` alone exits 0 when the include glob matches nothing; this asserts the suite actually ran. See scripts/test-floor.mjs.
scripts.test:bridge: bash -c 'if [ -d packages/bridge/tests ]; then bash scripts/dev-bridge.sh --exec python -m pytest packages/bridge/tests -q; else echo "no packages/bridge/tests yet (WP-02 owns them) - skipping"; fi'
scripts.//lint: --max-warnings 0: no-unused-vars, consistent-type-imports and no-explicit-any are all `warn`, so without this a warning count can grow without limit and CI never notices.
scripts.//parity:engine: The engine-parity gate: differential equivalence of the TypeScript engine vs. golden snapshots (and vs. real PyMOL with --remote). See scripts/parity-engine.mjs and tools/parity.
scripts.//docs:api:check: CI gate. Regenerate the MDX API reference from the committed api-schema.json and fail if the committed pages drifted -- same discipline as the committed TypeScript in packages/protocol/src/generated/.
scripts.//docs:coverage: The doc-coverage ratchet. Prints a scoreboard; pass --max-undocumented N to gate. See scripts/doc-coverage.mjs.
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc pnpm-workspace.yaml vitest.workspace.ts "scripts/*.mjs" "apps/**/*" "packages/**/*" docs/README.md "!**/dist/**" "!**/generated/**" "!**/node_modules/**"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc pnpm-workspace.yaml vitest.workspace.ts "scripts/*.mjs" "apps/**/*" "packages/**/*" docs/README.md "!**/dist/**" "!**/generated/**" "!**/node_modules/**"
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo *.tsbuildinfo apps/*/dist apps/*/.turbo apps/*/*.tsbuildinfo apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/.turbo packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/node_modules node_modules
